Electrical uses kW = √3 × V × FLA × PF × load factor. FLA is the nameplate maximum, so running kW is an estimate until you clamp a meter on the MCC. Air SCFM per machine is my engineering default; CTF and Lantech publish air figures on request.

Verify before use
• Geometry traced from the OEM PDF, ~8.6 px/ft (35'-0" bay), ±3 ft. Function labels are my reading, not OEM names.
• Bottle path from the accumulation table to the robot cell is not legible on the PDF — not animated.
• Sim chain: filler → AT-101 → bottle labeler → case packer → sealer → case labeler → checkweigher → 2 palletizers. Sealer/labeler/CW/palletizers are NOT on the OEM sheet — modeled as logic only. Labeler position in the chain is assumed.
• Equipment list and the 24,000 BPH (400 BPM, 12 oz crown) rating are the CTF line basis (ASSUMED until the CTF GA and data sheets are in); the plan geometry is the reference layout of a 500 BPM glass line, reused for the CTF line until its GA drawing is in. Only the 12 oz speed is documented; other sizes, the packer ceiling and the 12/12.5 oz case pattern are my estimates (Capabilities tab).
• Cases/pallet for 500, 670 and 750 mL come from your A1 production_runs. MTBF/MTTR, breakage 0.5% and station rates not on the sheet are ASSUMED. production_runs has no run-hours or downtime, so real OEE cannot be computed yet.
• The filler is a crimp-crown beer filler: no ROPP, not rated for CSD, no pasteurizer. production_runs has no run-hours or downtime, so real OEE can't be computed yet.
